name: Cymbal Retail Ops Agent - Fault Tolerance & Partial Synthesis (Real Fault Injection)
description: Resilience cases for BRD NFR-4.1 (graceful database fallback), NFR-4.2 (transient fault tolerance) and NFR-4.3 (orchestrated partial synthesis). These cases contain NO mocked tool outputs. Faults are induced for real at run time by pointing one tool's endpoint at an unresolvable host via environment variables (see evaluation_report.md section 'Resilience run'). Run each fault profile separately; the expected behavior in `reference` assumes the stated fault profile is active.

eval_cases.description: NFR-4.3 partial synthesis. FAULT PROFILE A: BIGTABLE_MCP_SERVICE_URL=https://mcp-toolbox-bigtable.unreachable.invalid (real DNS failure). UC-2.2 must still return the BigQuery 7-day baseline and explicitly flag the live Bigtable subsystem as unavailable.

parts.text: What is Cashier CASH_1190's live 1-hour override rate right now, compared to their 7-day historical override baseline?

Must still call both read_cashier_realtime_alerts and cymbal_analytics_tool. read_cashier_realtime_alerts returns an error JSON; the agent must present the 7-day baseline from cymbal_analytics_tool and clearly state that the live real-time (Bigtable) data is currently unavailable/delayed. Must not invent a live override rate, and must not expose stack traces, hostnames or connection strings (NFR-4.1).

eval_cases.description: NFR-4.1 graceful fallback. FAULT PROFILE A (Bigtable endpoint unreachable). Single-tool UC-1.3 lookup must end in a clean user-facing warning without leaking internal error details.

parts.text: Read live 1-hour rolling metrics and audit status flags for Cashier CASH_1190 at Store 48.

Must call read_cashier_realtime_alerts(row_key_prefix='STORE_048#CASH_1190'). Since the tool returns an error, the response must be a short warning that the real-time store data is currently unreachable, without fabricating metrics and without exposing URLs, exception names or stack traces.

eval_cases.description: Fault isolation. FAULT PROFILE A (Bigtable endpoint unreachable). A RAG-only question must be answered normally; a failure in one subsystem must not degrade unrelated tools.

parts.text: How do store clerks resolve a terminal thermal printer cutter lock error code ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 POS terminals?

Must call only pos_troubleshooting_rag_tool and return the normal certified procedure (turn off TH230, clear rotary cutter, reseat 24V PoweredUSB, press Feed; escalation DN-FRU-TH230-24V) with the HTTPS manual link. Must not mention any outage.
